description: This file defines a PHP class 'EmployeeAllowedSkillModel' that models allowed skills for employees within the OrangeHRM system API. It uses traits for serialization and normalizable interfaces, and constructs an instance from a 'Skill' entity, setting identifiable filters.

classes.name: EmployeeAllowedSkillModel
classes.description: A model representing an allowed skill for employees, used in API responses within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a Skill entity and defines the properties for serialization.
